title: Data centres of 500 kW or more must report their energy use
summary: A delegated regulation under the Energy Efficiency Directive requires operators of data centres with an installed IT power demand of at least 500 kW to report energy and water indicators every year to a European database. The data is published only in aggregated form.

title: InvestAI announced: EUR 20 billion for AI Gigafactories
summary: Commission President von der Leyen announced that EUR 20 billion would be mobilised to finance several AI Gigafactories across the EU.

title: General-Purpose AI Code of Practice received
summary: The Commission received the final General-Purpose AI Code of Practice from independent experts: a voluntary tool explaining how providers can meet their AI Act obligations, including safety and security for models with systemic risk.
source_title: Commission: guidelines for providers of general-purpose AI models

title: AI Act rules for general-purpose AI models start to apply
summary: Providers of general-purpose AI models must meet transparency and copyright obligations. Models trained with more than 10^25 floating-point operations are presumed to carry systemic risk, and their providers must notify the Commission and assess and mitigate those risks. The Commission says this threshold is under review.

title: Six more AI Factories selected: 19 across 16 member states
summary: Six further AI Factories were selected, bringing the network to 19 AI Factories across 16 member states, complemented by 13 smaller AI Factory Antennas announced on 13 October 2025.
source_title: Commission: EU announces AI Factories Antennas

actor: European Commission and EuroHPC Joint Undertaking
title: Call for tenders for up to seven AI Gigafactories
summary: The EU opened a call for tenders for up to seven AI Gigafactories, with up to EUR 10 billion of EU and national funding expected to unlock at least EUR 20 billion of private investment. Selection is expected in early 2027.

actor: German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs
title: Germany publishes its data-centre register
summary: Germany's energy-efficiency register for data centres was published, giving official data on data centres in Germany for the first time. The Federal Environment Agency says the coverage of published data centres is highly incomplete.

title: Commission's enforcement powers for general-purpose AI apply
summary: From 2 August 2026, the Commission can enforce the obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models, including with fines. Models already on the market before 2 August 2025 must comply by 2 August 2027.
source_title: Commission: guidelines for providers of general-purpose AI models

title: Data centres used 23% of Ireland's metered electricity in 2025
summary: The CSO reported that data centres used 7,663 GWh of electricity in 2025, 23% of all metered electricity, up from 5% in 2015. The figures come from meter data.
source_title: CSO: Data Centres Metered Electricity Consumption 2025

title: A rating scheme and label for data centres adopted
summary: The Commission adopted a delegated regulation setting up a common EU rating scheme for data centres. Its label would show each data centre's name, operator and location. A delegated regulation enters into force only if the Parliament and Council do not object.

title: AI Gigafactories deadline extended for Lot 1
summary: The deadline for Lot 1 tenders was extended to 4 February 2027 so member states can complete budget procedures; Lot 2 still closes on 3 December 2026.
source_title: EuroHPC JU: AI Gigafactories call for tenders
